articles.title: Jersey Mike's CEO says the stock is 'undervalued' after post-IPO slump
articles.summary: Late night Sub? Jersey Mike's CEO said it could be an opportunity.
articles.body:
Jersey Mike's ( JMKE ) stock has remained under pressure since its IPO earlier this year, but CEO Charlie Morrison is confident in the state of the sandwich chain.

The stock has fallen nearly 13% since it debuted on the New York Stock Exchange at $21 per share in late July. It fell to as low as $16.09 in early October and closed the month at around $18 per share.

"While the stock has been challenged, we think the shares are generally undervalued," Morrison told Yahoo Finance. He added that the chain is aiming for "long-term sustainable" growth and has posted 20 consecutive quarters of positive same-store sales growth.

In the third quarter, same-store sales rose 3%, driven by transaction growth and 9% unit growth, Jersey Mike's reported this past Wednesday.

However, the company lowered its outlook for the year, and Morrison attributed the recent softness in September and October to lower consumer sentiment amid the "spike in interest rates and spikes in fuel prices."

Morrison mentioned that Jersey Mike's $100 million share buyback program announced this past week "showcases the confidence we have in the business."

Catering and acquiring new customers seem to be the sandwich chain's focus in the near term.

"Sandwiches are very portable," Morrison said. "They're used for lunch events all the time and we think Jersey Mike's should be a leader in the catering side of the business."

Catering sales have increased roughly 17% so far this year and make up about 4% of sales, up from 3% historically.

Some Wall Street analysts agree with the push: "We remain bullish on the long-term opportunity, as we believe Jersey Mike's product is particularly well suited to the occasion," TD Cowen analyst Andrew Charles wrote in a note to investors.

Craving a sub at 12 a.m.? Jersey Mike's may be open after dark in the future.

Morrison noted that while Jersey Mike's primary customer skews older, younger customers, ages 18 to 34, make up a core part of its growing customer base.

"Our stores do close relatively early compared to most brands in the US, and as we approach this younger audience, we know that they tend to be more night owls than perhaps our typical customer base," he said.

Jersey Mike's closing times vary by franchisee and location, but most stores close around 9 p.m. or 10 p.m. Morrison, who previously served as the CEO of Wingstop ( WING ), could take a page out of the late night wing chain's playbook.

"I was with Wingstop for many years, and we were open late and knew that younger audience really, really well and knew what they're craving during that time frame," Morrison said. "I don't think alcohol needs to play into it to be successful, but I do think there is a real opportunity to still share of those occasions over time."

Jersey Mike's plans to test that approach for now before making any changes to its hours.

articles.body: NEW DELHI: New Delhi: The country’s first indigenous high-speed train, B28, has undergone the vehicle body shell test, also known as the “squeeze test”, an important safety assessment to determine whether a train’s car body can withstand heavy external forces and pressure without excessive deformation or structural failure in case of a collision or crash.The test was conducted at BEML’s production facility in Bengaluru. The central PSU is manufacturing the first two of indigenous bullet trains, each comprising eight coaches. The trains have been designed for an operating speed of 249 kmph and a testing speed of 275 kmph, as per a BEML tender document.People aware of the development said the squeeze test is crucial as the trains will operate at high speeds and their car bodies must be capable of withstanding heavy forces in the event of a collision or accident.“After the successful completion of this test, the prototype should ideally be ready in less than six months. Since the B28 (Bharat 28) train is not being built on Japanese Shinkansen technology, the development process should not take much time. The squeeze test establishes whether the body retains its shape under pressure and whether the passenger compartment maintains its structural integrity,” an official said.The railways plans to begin trial runs of B28 on the 100-km Surat-Vapi section of the Ahmedabad-Mumbai High Speed Rail corridor by May-June 2027. articles.title: ACA open enrollment: Premium hikes and what else to expect for 2027
articles.summary: The window to sign up for 2027 healthcare coverage under the Affordable Care Act opens Sunday in most states.  Here's what you need to know.
articles.body:
The window to sign up for 2027 healthcare coverage under the Affordable Care Act opens Sunday in most states.

With healthcare costs a top concern for Americans already slammed by sticky inflation, this year's enrollment — running through Dec. 15 to get a plan that starts Jan. 1 — comes at a time when monthly premiums are climbing and insurers are shutting plans.

For 2027, average full-price premiums on federal and state-run marketplace plans are set to increase by roughly 13%, according to a new KFF analysis published on Friday. Most price hikes across the country range from 10% to 20%.

States that run their own enrollment platforms are seeing premium increases of 16%, per the researchers.

The increases are being driven by a rise in overall medical care costs, inflation, and labor shortages.

"Automatically renewing your current coverage before looking at alternatives is a big mistake," Louise Norris, a health policy analyst for healthinsurance.org, told Yahoo Finance.

This will be the second year in a row of double-digit increases. For many people, 2026 ACA premiums jumped more than 20% and higher earners lost premium subsidies entirely.

Premium hikes vary widely from state to state. In Vermont, for example, there is likely to be an average increase of 3% compared to an average hike of almost 28% in Arizona.

In about half the states, the plans available are from the same insurance companies in 2027 as they were in 2026.

But those plans could be changing in terms of what they cover, what providers are in the network, what drugs are covered, the deductible amount, and the out-of-pocket maximum. Those are the sorts of things that change every year, Norris said.

And there are quite a few folks whose 2026 plan is not available for renewal next year. In 26 states, at least one insurer is leaving the marketplace.

"If it's your plan, it's a big issue to you," she added.

As of this past week, 11 carriers have announced that they will exit the ACA marketplaces, either in some or all states. Cigna, which has more than 350,000 ACA enrollees, will exit all 11 states where it offers ACA plans.

"We did not make this decision lightly and appreciate the importance of ensuring patients have continuity through the transition, and we will support members through their open enrollment transitions into 2027," Brian Evanko, Cigna Group's president and CEO, said in an earnings call. "This is a small business for us today, and it's been shrinking in recent years."

articles.summary: NEW DELHI: The Aircraft Accident Investigation Bureau (AAIB) has sought a greater collaboration between civil aviation and defence authorities as a number
articles.body: NEW DELHI: The Aircraft Accident Investigation Bureau (AAIB) has sought a greater collaboration between civil aviation and defence authorities as a number of airports where commercial flights operate are defence airfields. Submitting its final report in a case at the Navy’s Dabolim Airport in Goa where an Air India Express flight and a Naval aircraft had ended up on the same runway at the same time, the AAIB has sought the establishment of “a formal framework for collaboration between DGCA/AAIB and defence on a priority basis” to ensure exchange of unclassified information and evidence for investigation of an incident or accident.On April 3, 2026, a scheduled flight of AI Express was to take off from Dabolim for Delhi. Due to misunderstanding and miscommunication between the flight deck and ATC, it entered an active runway when a Naval “fighter was rolling” and the incident was a “near miss”. “On seeing the Navy aircraft at lift off, in the opposite direction the pilot-in-command of AI Express 1109 mentioned to the trainee first officer that the fighter did a low pass, as per the cockpit flight recorder recording,” says the report.In its safety recommendations, AAIB has asked the Airports Authority of India (AAI) “to issue a circular to sensitise air traffic controllers for emphasising the use of standard phraseology and to review the use of phrases like ‘expect backtrack’ by ground controllers which can be easily misinterpreted as ‘enter backtrack’. ATCOs must listen carefully to the read-back and correct any factual error or any apparent misunderstanding.”The investigator has asked a taxiway of Dabolim airport to be “considered as a hotspot due to its proximity with bays of civil apron and increased probability of the risk of potential ground collisions and runway incursions.”The Navy has been advised to “publish installation of stop bars and their usage at Dabolim airport (and it may) consider establishing a standard frequency change over procedure for civil traffic transitioning from the ground frequency to the tower frequency, in order to avoid recurring confusion regarding the appropriate frequency to be used.”The crew of the AI Express flight has been asked to “undergo counselling and pilot-in-command to undergo training on the safety lapses that resulted in the runway incursion due to lack of operational clarity and communication miss outs.” The airline has to issue a circular to “sensitise all crew for the lapses encountered in this occurrence.”You use AI every day. articles.body:
The scheduling complications leading up to Game 6 of this year's WNBA Finals fueled plenty of contentious conversation . Ultimately, however, the much-discussed and controversial 12:30 p.m. ET start didn't affect the attendance at Atlanta's State Farm Arena on Thursday afternoon.

The Dream announced a sellout, and the crowd's energy was palpable throughout the home team's series-extending 80-69 victory over the Golden State Valkyries .

Plus, according to a Saturday release from USA Sports PR, Game 6 was the fifth most-watched WNBA Finals game on cable to date.

USA Sports' coverage averaged 1.5 million viewers across linear platforms — USA Network, E! and SYFY — and streaming, which was led by Peacock. That figure, based on Nielsen panel-only data and digital data from Adobe Analytics, represents a 4% increase in viewership from last year's WNBA Finals series-clinching game, which the Las Vegas Aces won 97-86 to sweep the Phoenix Mercury. Granted, the Aces came into that matchup with a 3-0 series lead, but it tipped off in prime time at 8 p.m. ET on a Friday.

It's also worth noting that, when factoring in encore presentations on USA Network and CNBC in the original 8 p.m. ET broadcast window on Thursday, USA Sports averaged a total of 1.7 million viewers for this year's Game 6.

That signified the second time USA Sports has averaged that many viewers for a rescheduled WNBA Finals game, after the third game in the series was the most-watched WNBA Finals Game 3 since 1999 , following its move from Oct. 22 to Oct. 21.

Heading into the series, the location of the Dream's home games was undecided. The team's arena, the Gateway Center Arena at College Park, holds just 3,500 fans. Atlanta had been hosting its playoff games at State Farm Arena, which seats north of 17,000 people, but is also where the NBA's Hawks play.

In order to keep playing at State Farm Arena, the Dream and the W had to work with the Hawks' regular-season schedule, leading to a particularly large headache during the heart of the WNBA Finals.

If the stadium was going to fit both a previously scheduled Hawks game on Thursday night, as well as Game 6 of the WNBA Finals that same day, Game 6 was going to have to tip off early, a highly scrutinized compromise.

Dream ownership clarified this week that, months ago, and again during the playoffs, it raised concerns about scheduling conflicts like that one . Those concerns, according to Dream ownership, "did not receive the attention, nor the urgency that they deserved."

There ended up not being a rushed championship celebration Thursday afternoon, as the Valkyries — then up 3-2 in the series — were defeated by an Atlanta squad that came out firing from beyond the arc.

Even though the Dream finished the first quarter with a 17-point lead and went up by as many as 25 points, Golden State rallied to make things interesting late. Watch parties — including those in the West, where it was still morning at the time of tipoff — were popping with fervor .

Up next is the first-ever WNBA Finals Game 7. Whoever wins will take home their first league title in franchise history.

The winner-take-all contest is taking place Saturday night at 8 p.m. ET in San Francisco's Chase Center.

articles.title: Judge tosses Trump’s lawsuit against Wall Street Journal again, this time for good
articles.summary: A federal judge on Saturday dismissed President Donald Trump’s defamation lawsuit against The Wall Street Journal over its reporting on a lewd birthday letter to Jeffrey Epstein bearing Trump’s name.
articles.body: A federal judge on Saturday dismissed President Donald Trump’s defamation lawsuit against The Wall Street Journal over its reporting on a lewd birthday letter to Jeffrey Epstein bearing Trump’s name. US District Judge Darrin P. Gayles ruled that Trump failed to plausibly allege that the Rupert Murdoch-owned newspaper acted with “actual malice” when it published the story. Gayles rejected the president’s argument that The Journal should have withheld its story after he denied writing the letter, saying such a requirement would violate the First Amendment. “Were that the law, any time a public figure or his team denies an accusation, journalists would be immediately blocked from publishing negative or contradictory press,” the judge wrote. The ruling is another stinging defeat in the president’s legal crusade against the American news media and is sure to be celebrated by the press freedom groups that have denounced Trump’s suits. Gayles previously dismissed the $20 billion lawsuit in April, ruling that Trump’s original complaint relied on “formulaic” assertions of malice that came “nowhere close” to the legal standard for a public figure. But the judge dismissed the case without prejudice and gave Trump an opportunity to file an amended complaint addressing those shortcomings. In Saturday’s ruling, Gayles found that Trump’s revised complaint still failed to resolve those issues and dismissed the case with prejudice. “We’re pleased with the court’s decision,” a spokesperson for Dow Jones, the Journal’s parent, told CNN. When asked for comment, the White House referred CNN to Trump’s personal lawyers. CNN has reached out to the president’s legal team. Trump sued The Journal, its parent companies, Murdoch and two reporters in July 2025 after the newspaper reported on the sexually suggestive letter. Trump denied writing it and accused The Journal of knowingly publishing a false story. The case was especially unusual because Trump brought it while serving as president. Legal analysts who spoke with CNN said they could not recall another instance of a sitting president suing a news outlet over a story. However, it was also part of a recognizable, long-running pattern for Trump — using the courts to pressure news organizations over unflattering coverage of him. During his second term, Trump has also filed a $15 billion defamation case against The New York Times over its coverage of his 2024 campaign. A judge dismissed the original complaint last year but allowed Trump to refile. In July, the judge deferred a decision on the Times’ motion to dismiss and directed Trump to revise his complaint again, which he did in August. Late last year, Trump sued the BBC for $10 billion over its editing of his January 6, 2021, speech in a documentary about the Capitol attack. The British broadcaster has vowed to defend the case in court. One month before taking office, Trump sued Iowa pollster J. Ann Selzer, her polling company, The Des Moines Register and its parent company, over a poll released days before the 2024 election showing him trailing Democratic nominee Kamala Harris in Iowa. A judge dismissed that lawsuit with prejudice in September. Legal experts have deemed these lawsuits frivolous and full of holes, but warn that winning may be besides the point for Trump: The publicity and threat of protracted litigation can pressure news outlets and chill aggressive reporting. This story has been updated with additional information.

articles.title: FBI says North Korea was behind the $6.3 billion Binance crypto hack
articles.summary: Crypto exchange Binance said Saturday it has been able to replace 90% of the amount stolen after a $6.3 billion hack of its platform that the FBI blamed on North Korea.
articles.body: Crypto exchange Binance said Saturday it has been able to replace 90% of the amount stolen after a $6.3 billion hack of its platform that the FBI blamed on North Korea. Binance said it was able to replace the funds taken in the record hack by using company money to buy new tokens. The remaining 10% consists of tokens that are less liquid, meaning they may take longer to buy, it said in a statement posted on X. "We've now replenished 90% of the stolen assets, and we're committed to covering the remaining 10%. Our users will not bear the financial impact of this incident," co-CEO Richard Teng said on X. Crypto prices fell Friday, while Binance — the world's biggest crypto exchange — sought to reassure customers that their funds were safe. The FBI on Saturday said the North Korean state-sponsored unit known as TraderTraitor was responsible for the attack. Members of the unit were observed by law enforcement converting stolen assets into the cryptocurrency ethereum, the FBI said in a statement, adding that it expects "further laundering" of the assets through the use of related technology. Teng said Friday that the breach was a "complex attack" involving a compromised laptop and malicious software designed to delete evidence of its activity, making it harder to trace and investigate. After the hack, the exchange stopped allowing customers to withdraw their funds, but it said Saturday it was still on track to reopen withdrawals Sunday. Binance said it has set aside around $6.34 billion of company funds internally to cover the losses. The money spent re-buying tokens came from using part of its $1 billion Secure Asset Fund for Users (SAFU), a bitcoin reserve it holds to protect customers in the event of security breaches, as well as some of its Futures Insurance Fund, and the company's own corporate treasury, it said on X. Binance also said it had taken a new snapshot of assets held on its platform as of 0000 GMT Saturday, as part of its proof-of-reserves process. Users holding the 10 listed tokens — BTC, ETH, USDT, BNB, SOL, USDC, XRP, USD1, RLUSD, and ZEC — would be able to verify that their assets were backed at a minimum ratio of 1:1 once the full proof was available, it said.

articles.title: Bolsa Família 2026: veja calendário de pagamentos em novembro | G1
articles.standfirst: Primeiros a receber serão os beneficiários com Número de Identificação Social (NIS) com final 1. Pagamento mínimo previsto é de R$ 691 por família, com possíveis adicionais.
articles.summary: Primeiros a receber serão os beneficiários com Número de Identificação Social (NIS) com final 1.  Pagamento mínimo previsto é de R$ 691 por família, com possíveis adicionais.
articles.body:
A Caixa Econômica Federal inicia os pagamentos de novembro do Bolsa Família no dia 16. Os primeiros a receber serão os beneficiários com Número de Identificação Social (NIS) com final 1.

Este é o segundo mês de pagamentos com os valores reajustados pelo governo. Anunciado em 17 de setembro , o aumento elevou o piso do Bolsa Família de R$ 600 para R$ 691 e também ampliou os benefícios complementares. (leia mais abaixo)

🤔 Para saber a data correta de recebimento, a família deve verificar o último dígito do NIS , impresso no cartão do programa. Assim, é possível consultar o dia correspondente no calendário oficial de pagamentos.

Em outubro, o governo federal anunciou a antecipação dos pagamentos do Bolsa Família para os últimos meses do ano, sob a justificativa de reduzir os impactos do super El Niño sobre as famílias mais vulneráveis. (entenda abaixo)

O dinheiro costuma ser disponibilizado nos últimos 10 dias úteis de cada mês, de forma escalonada. A exceção é o mês de dezembro, quando os pagamentos são antecipados. Com a mudança, porém, ficaram concentrados em apenas três dias.

Veja como ficou o calendário do Bolsa Família para novembro de 2026:

16/11: pagamentos para NIS com final 1 ;

17/11: pagamentos para NIS com final 2 ;

18/11: pagamentos para NIS com finais 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9 e 0.

O governo federal explicou que a unificação foi adotada para outubro, novembro e dezembro , meses em que o Super El Niño pode intensificar seus efeitos no país.

Veja abaixo perguntas e respostas sobre o Bolsa Família.

Bolsa Família — Foto: Luis Lima Jr/FotoArena/Estadão Conteúdo

A principal regra para receber o benefício é ter renda mensal familiar de até R$ 218 por pessoa.

Para se enquadrar do programa, é preciso somar a renda total e dividir pelo número de pessoas. Caso o valor fique abaixo dos R$ 218 , a família está elegível ao Bolsa Família.

Os beneficiários também precisam arcar com contrapartidas, como:

manter crianças e adolescentes na escola;

fazer o acompanhamento pré-natal (no caso de gestantes);

manter as carteiras de vacinação atualizadas.

Com a mudança anunciada pelo governo , o Bolsa Família passou a prever o pagamento mínimo de R$ 691 por família.

A medida também elevou de R$ 142 para R$ 164 o chamado Benefício de Renda de Cidadania . Esse é o valor pago por integrante da família pelo programa.

🔎 Se uma família elegível tiver três pessoas , por exemplo, a soma será de R$ 492 (3 × R$ 164). Como o valor fica abaixo do piso, a família receberá o complemento necessário para chegar a R$ 691.

🔎 Já uma família de cinco pessoas terá como base R$ 820 (5 × R$ 164).

Além do piso, há benefícios complementares, que também foram reajustados:

R$ 173 por criança de até 6 anos (eram R$ 150);

R$ 58 por criança ou adolescente de 7 a 17 anos (eram R$ 50);

R$ 58 por bebê de até 6 meses (eram R$ 50).

Na prática, portanto, o valor recebido por cada família varia conforme sua composição e pode aumentar com os benefícios adicionais para crianças, adolescentes e gestantes.

Os beneficiários precisam se inscrever no Cadastro Único (CadÚnico) — principal instrumento do governo federal para a inclusão de famílias de baixa renda em programas sociais — e aguardar uma análise de enquadramento.

Estar no Cadastro Único não significa a entrada automática nos programas sociais do governo, uma vez que cada um deles tem regras específicas. Mas o cadastro é pré-requisito para que a inscrição seja avaliada.

Os beneficiários recebem e podem movimentar os valores pelo aplicativo Caixa TEM e internet banking . Assim, não é necessário ir até uma agência da Caixa Econômica Federal — que é responsável pelo pagamento do Bolsa Família — para realizar o saque.

Segundo a Caixa, os beneficiários também podem utilizar o cartão do programa para realizar compras nos estabelecimentos comerciais, por meio da função de débito.

Além disso, há a opção de realizar saques nos terminais de autoatendimento, casas lotéricas e correspondentes Caixa Aqui, além das agências da Caixa.

articles.title: Saque-aniversário FGTS novembro: veja calendário e quem pode sacar | G1
articles.standfirst: Veja as datas do saque-aniversário do FGTS 2026 em novembro e entenda quem tem direito ao pagamento.
articles.summary: Veja as datas do saque-aniversário do FGTS 2026 em novembro e entenda quem tem direito ao pagamento.
articles.body:
Saque-aniversário FGTS novembro. — Foto: Reprodução/Jornal Nacional

O saque-aniversário do FGTS de novembro de 2026 já está disponível para os trabalhadores que nasceram neste mês e aderiram à modalidade. O dinheiro pode ser retirado entre 1º de novembro e 30 de dezembro de 2026.

O saque-aniversário permite que o trabalhador retire, uma vez por ano, uma parte do saldo disponível nas contas do FGTS no mês de seu aniversário. A adesão à modalidade é opcional. Quem não fez a opção permanece no modelo tradicional, chamado de saque-rescisão.

Calendário do saque-aniversário FGTS 2026

O calendário do saque-aniversário do FGTS segue o mês de nascimento do trabalhador. O valor fica disponível a partir do primeiro dia útil do mês de aniversário e pode ser retirado por até três meses.

Janeiro : de 2 de janeiro a 31 de março de 2026

Fevereiro : de 2 de fevereiro a 30 de abril de 2026

Março : de 3 de março a 29 de maio de 2026

Abril : de 1º de abril a 30 de junho de 2026

Maio : de 4 de maio a 31 de julho de 2026

Junho : de 1º de junho a 31 de agosto de 2026

Julho : de 1º de julho a 30 de setembro de 2026

Agosto : de 3 de agosto a 30 de outubro de 2026

Setembro : de 1º de setembro a 30 de novembro de 2026

Outubro : de 1º de outubro a 31 de dezembro de 2026

Novembro : de 2 de novembro de 2026 a 29 de janeiro de 2027

Dezembro : de 1º de dezembro de 2026 a 26 de fevereiro de 2027

Assim, para quem nasceu em setembro, o saque-aniversário fica disponível durante todo o mês de setembro e pode ser retirado até 30 de novembro de 2026.

Quem tem direito ao saque-aniversário do FGTS em novembro?

Pode receber o saque-aniversário FGTS de novembro o trabalhador que:

possui saldo disponível em uma conta ativa ou inativa do FGTS

O valor que pode ser retirado depende do saldo total disponível nas contas do FGTS. A regra estabelece diferentes faixas de saldo, com um percentual que pode ser sacado e uma parcela adicional fixa em determinadas faixas.

Quanto maior o saldo, menor é o percentual que pode ser retirado. Confira abaixo quanto é permetido retirar do FGTS de acordo com seu montante:

Até R$ 500: alíquota de 50%, sem parcela adicional;

De R$ 500,01 até R$ 1.000: alíquota de 40%, mais R$ 50 de parcela adicional;

De R$ 1.000,01 até R$ 5.000: alíquota de 30%, mais R$ 150 de parcela adicional;

De R$ 5.000,01 até R$ 10.000: alíquota de 20%, mais R$ 650 de parcela adicional;

De R$ 10.000,01 até R$ 15.000: alíquota de 15%, mais R$ 1.150 de parcela adicional;

De R$ 15.000,01 até R$ 20.000: alíquota de 10%, mais R$ 1.900 de parcela adicional;

Acima de R$ 20.000: alíquota de 5%, mais R$ 2.900 de parcela adicional.

Como consultar o saque-aniversário do FGTS 2026?

O trabalhador pode consultar informações sobre o saldo e o saque-aniversário pelos canais oficiais do FGTS, no site da Caixa Econômica Federal . A modalidade também pode ser consultada e solicitada pelo aplicativo FGTS.

É importante verificar se a opção pelo saque-aniversário foi realizada antes de esperar pela liberação do dinheiro.

Qual a diferença entre saque-aniversário e saque-rescisão?

O saque-aniversário permite retirar anualmente uma parte do saldo do FGTS no mês de nascimento. Já o saque-rescisão é a modalidade padrão do fundo e permite, em caso de demissão sem justa causa, o saque integral da conta, além da multa rescisória quando devida.

Quem escolhe o saque-aniversário e é demitido sem justa causa não pode sacar o saldo integral da conta por causa da demissão. Nesse caso, pode sacar a multa rescisória, quando devida, enquanto o restante do saldo permanece no FGTS, salvo outras hipóteses previstas em lei.

Até quando quem nasceu em setembro pode sacar o FGTS de aniversário?

O trabalhador nascido em setembro que aderiu ao saque-aniversário pode retirar o dinheiro de 1º de setembro a 30 de novembro de 2026.

Depois desse prazo, caso o valor não seja retirado, ele retorna para a conta do FGTS e poderá ser movimentado conforme as regras do fundo.

articles.title: Apple reclaims world's most valuable company title as Nvidia slips amid AI investment concerns
articles.summary: Apple has overtaken Nvidia to become the world's most valuable company, reclaiming the top position as concerns over the rising cost of artificial
articles.body: Apple has overtaken Nvidia to become the world's most valuable company, reclaiming the top position as concerns over the rising cost of artificial intelligence (AI) investments weigh on technology stocks.At the close of trading on Friday, Apple's market capitalisation stood at $5.03 trillion, ahead of Nvidia's $4.93 trillion. The change came even as both companies' shares ended lower. Apple declined 1.2 per cent, while Nvidia fell 4.2 per cent.This is the first time Apple has moved ahead of Nvidia since briefly holding the top spot in late July.The shift in rankings comes at a time when investors are reassessing the financial implications of the massive investments being made by technology companies in AI. Several major firms, including Amazon, Intel, Alphabet and Meta Platforms, have faced pressure following their latest financial results, adding to uncertainty over the returns from AI-related expenditure.Apple's comparatively limited spending on capital-intensive AI infrastructure has helped distinguish it from its rivals. While companies such as Nvidia have benefited from the surge in demand for AI computing, the scale of investment across the sector has raised questions about its long-term financial sustainability.The difference is also reflected in their stock performance. Apple's shares have risen 27% in 2026, more than twice the gain recorded by Nvidia, making it the strongest performer among the Magnificent Seven technology companies.Apple is also expected to see its free cash flow rise 38% to $142 billion in fiscal 2026, which ended on September 30. In contrast, Alphabet and Amazon have seen their free cash flow turn negative amid heavy spending, increasing their need to tap debt markets for funding. Higher interest rates have further raised borrowing costs.The pressure has extended beyond the largest technology companies. articles.title: Binance to resume withdrawals after recovering 95% of $6.3 billion crypto theft
articles.summary: Binance, the world's largest cryptocurrency exchange, has said it will resume withdrawals in phases after securing 95% of the $6.3 billion in digital
articles.body: Binance, the world's largest cryptocurrency exchange, has said it will resume withdrawals in phases after securing 95% of the $6.3 billion in digital assets stolen from its platform in what is being described as the world's largest cryptocurrency heist.The first phase of withdrawals will begin between 0600 and 0900 GMT on Sunday and cover bitcoin, ether, BNB, Solana, XRP, dogecoin and several other tokens, Reuters reported.The exchange said the remaining 5% of the stolen assets comprised less liquid tokens that could take longer to source in the required quantities.Binance announced the update in a post on X late on Saturday.The Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) has attributed the cyberattack to TraderTraitor, a North Korean state-sponsored hacking unit.The bureau said on Saturday that members of the group had been observed converting the stolen assets into Ethereum.FBI links crypto heist to North Korean hacking unitIn a statement, the FBI identified TraderTraitor as responsible for the attack and said it expected further attempts to launder the stolen funds using related technology.The bureau also urged cryptocurrency exchanges, blockchain analytics companies and other industry participants to block transactions associated with identified addresses to prevent the stolen money from being moved to conceal its origins.The FBI said its investigation found that the hackers were converting the stolen assets primarily into Ethereum. It expects the group to attempt further conversions through decentralised finance (DeFi) platforms and instant swap services.TraderTraitor has also been linked to a $1.5 billion hack of cryptocurrency exchange Bybit last year.North Korea has for years denied using state-linked cyber units for espionage, financial theft and revenue generation.Trump says investigators are still examining North Korea linkUS President Donald Trump appeared to question whether North Korea's involvement in the Binance attack had been established.Asked about the incident by reporters at a Halloween party at his Mar-a-Lago estate in Florida on Saturday night, Trump said, “I'm not concerned. We're learning about it. We don't know if it's North Korea.”He added that investigators could still determine whether Pyongyang was responsible.Crypto expert Ari Redbord was quoted by news agency AP as saying that he expected the hackers to break the stolen assets into smaller amounts and attempt to move them through smaller exchanges to evade detection. The process could continue for months, he said.“It's bank robbery, in this case, at the speed of the Internet,” said Redbord, chief policy officer at blockchain intelligence firm TRM Labs.He added that investigators could track the funds in real time to build cases, disrupt laundering attempts and potentially recover the assets.“It's just this cat and mouse game,” he said.Binance promises customers full reimbursementThe theft took place on Thursday, when $6.3 billion in bitcoin and other digital currencies was stolen from Binance, the world's largest cryptocurrency exchange.The company said on Saturday that it had set aside enough of the same digital currencies to cover 90% of the missing assets and promised that customers would be fully reimbursed.Binance's latest update said it had now secured 95% of the stolen tokens, allowing it to begin restoring withdrawals in phases. The remaining assets are less liquid and may take longer to obtain in the required amounts.The FBI's warning about further laundering attempts comes as the exchange prepares to resume withdrawals for users affected by the incident.You use AI every day. articles.title: Commercial LPG cylinder price hiked by Rs 10 to Rs 2,820; ATF rates up for fourth straight month
articles.summary: NEW DELHI: The price of a 19-kg commercial LPG cylinder was increased by Rs 10 to Rs 2,820 from Sunday, marking the second consecutive monthly hike.
articles.body: NEW DELHI: The price of a 19-kg commercial LPG cylinder was increased by Rs 10 to Rs 2,820 from Sunday, marking the second consecutive monthly hike. Aviation turbine fuel (ATF) prices were also raised by Rs 1.37 per litre, according to state-owned oil companies.Commercial LPG, used mainly by hotels, restaurants and other businesses, had become costlier by Rs 62.50 per cylinder on October 1. The latest increase follows two consecutive monthly reductions of Rs 192 in August and Rs 183.50 in July. Prices had surged to a record high in June amid disruptions to global energy supplies and elevated international rates.A 19-kg commercial cylinder had cost Rs 1,740.50 in February before climbing to Rs 3,113.50 in June. The subsequent cuts brought some relief, but the September and October increases, followed by Sunday's revision, have reversed part of that decline.Meanwhile, the price of a 5-kg Free Trade LPG (FTL) cylinder for a new connection stands at Rs 1,903, while a refill costs Rs 782. FTL cylinders are smaller LPG cylinders sold at market-linked prices, outside the regular subsidised domestic LPG supply system.ATF, the fuel used by aircraft, was raised to Rs 138.50 per litre from Rs 137.12. This is the fourth consecutive monthly increase, following hikes of Rs 5 per litre in August, Rs 6.28 in September and Rs 16 in October. ATF accounts for up to 40 per cent of an airline's operating costs, and the latest increase is likely to add to carriers' expenses.The latest revisions reflect movements in international benchmark prices and the rupee-dollar exchange rate. ATF and commercial LPG rates are revised on the first day of every month and vary across states due to local taxes.Prices of domestic LPG, used by households, remained unchanged at Rs 942 for a 14.2-kg cylinder. Petrol and diesel prices were also left unchanged.You use AI every day. Now get your AI Quotient. Take the AIQ test.

articles.title: UPI crosses 25-billion transactions for first time in Oct despite MDR debate; daily value tops Rs 1 lakh crore
articles.summary: MUMBAI: UPI transactions crossed the 25-billion mark for the first time in October, while average daily transaction value breached Rs 1 lakh crore for the
articles.body: MUMBAI: UPI transactions crossed the 25-billion mark for the first time in October, while average daily transaction value breached Rs 1 lakh crore for the first time, signalling continued growth in digital payments despite the debate over the introduction of merchant discount rate (MDR) charges.UPI processed 25.47 billion transactions worth Rs 31.53 lakh crore in October, compared with 24.07 billion transactions valued at Rs 29.37 lakh crore in September. Transaction volumes rose 5.8% month on month, while the value of payments increased 7.4%.The increase was also reflected in daily averages. Average daily transactions rose 2.5% to 822 million in October from 802 million in September, while average daily transaction value increased 3.9% to Rs 1,01,707 crore from Rs 97,913 crore. On a year-on-year basis, transaction volumes grew 23% in October, matching September's growth rate. However, value growth moderated to 16% from 18% in September."The festive season drove this rise. Navratri and the big online sales fell in October, and people used UPI for bigger festive purchases along with their everyday payments. From April to August, the number of UPI payments kept rising, but their daily value stayed flat and the average payment kept getting smaller. In September and October, the value of payments grew faster than their number, and the average payment size went up for two months in a row," said Reeju Datta, cofounder Cashfree. "Last year, Dhanteras and Diwali fell in October, so most of the big festive buying happened in that month. This year, both fall in November. This is the main reason the value of payments grew 16% over last October, slower than the 23% rise in the number of payments. We expect strong growth in November, as the biggest shopping days of the season are still ahead. After the festive season, the important thing to watch will be whether people keep using UPI for larger payments," he added.The October numbers come amid a debate over the introduction of MDR charges, with merchant bodies and sections of the payments industry raising concerns about the potential impact on merchant acceptance and the cost of digital payments. The latest figures, however, show no immediate slowdown in aggregate UPI activity.The increase in October also coincides with the festive season, when spending on shopping, travel and other retail categories typically rises. The monthly figures do not, by themselves, establish the impact of MDR on individual merchant categories.UPI's continued expansion underlines its growing role in retail payments. The challenge for the payments ecosystem will be to sustain this growth while developing a viable revenue model for banks, payment service providers and technology companies that support the infrastructure.You use AI every day.
